w: Bolton Wanderers played here from 1895 to 1997, but Burnden Park is remembered for 1946, when it was the scene of one of the worst disasters in English football. L.S. Lowry painted the ground in 1953's Going to the Match. Demolished in 1999 - the ground is gone, the story is not.
s: Bolton's ground, gone since 1999 - a disaster and a Lowry painting
_facts: Home of Bolton Wanderers from 1895 to 1997; hosted the 1901 FA Cup final replay
Scene of one of the worst disasters in English football history in 1946
Depicted in L.S. Lowry's 1953 painting Going to the Match
Demolished in 1999, two years after Bolton moved to their new stadium
